first_order: asking CMU Redditors to make our mark in the bottom right corner
author: pkowian
text: Hey Redditors of CMU, you've probably seen [Reddit's April Fool's day thing](http://www.reddit.com/r/place) by now, so I was thinking, let's make our mark on there. I was thinking of putting [this](http://imgur.com/dVs8djO) in the bottom right corner.
note: Opening a collective CMU effort on the canvas.

author: slim-jong-un
text: Yo, can you get us started with the top black border? This sounds like a great idea.

first_order: telling the CMU group to move out of my spot
author: I_draw_ur_username
text: You guys are in my spot, move
note: The speaker identifies a collision with their own claimed space.

author: bobasdfbobasdf

There is space to the top left of there for the tartan

author: bobasdfbobasdf

first_order: sharing commands to maintain the CMU logo and make the tartan dog
author: bobasdfbobasdf
text: The first command is to maintain the CMU logo. The second script is to make the tartan dog.

first_order: asking for a picture to participate the old-fashioned way
author: SlightFigureOfSpeech
text: Uhhh, yeaaah, I went to CMU, but CS was not exactly my forte, haha. Any chance you can share a picture of the intended result & I can participate the old-fashioned way?
note: Contrasts manual participation with running the script.

first_order: pointing to the image and its top-left coordinates
author: bobasdfbobasdf
text: The image is tartan.png in the dropbox. The top left corner is at position 867,900

first_order: thanking someone for pointing out the images
author: SlightFigureOfSpeech
text: Oops, sorry, in my quick preview of the Dropbox files, I didn't even notice the .png images. Thanks!

first_order: moving the effort to writing Carnegie Mellon University above the tartan logo
author: bobasdfbobasdf
text: Our new effort is to write out Carnegie Mellon University above the tartan logo. The script and the new image is in this dropbox folder.

author: EpicVS

first_order: asking CMU to stop messing with our Galaga space ship
author: The_Real_Vince_Russo
text: Hi, I see you're trying to mess with the Galaga space ship my friends and I made. It took us a while to make it so we'd appreciate if you stopped it.

first_order: apologizing but saying we will write over the block
author: EVERmathYTHING
text: Sorry, we will be writing over the block from (866, 900) to (924, 917), since there isn't anywhere else we can do it.

first_order: warning that we will undo anything over Galaga
author: The_Real_Vince_Russo
text: Ok, but be warned that my friends and I will be undoing anything that goes over galaga.

first_order: challenging CMU for taking space and destroying two groups' art
author: LogaineFoam
text: I did the AU!! and I don't really like that you're taking up that much space and are going to destroy at least two group's art. Is just the Tartan and CMU not enough?
